text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert - P0 synth-check eu-west-1 failing (3/3 checks) - automatic page fired to #incidents and @oncall. Probe error: HTTP 502 gateway.
Maya Chen: Oncall here, I see the page. Pulling up canary dashboard and prober logs now.
Alex R: I can confirm — prober spike of 5xx in eu-west-1, 12% 5xx rate over last 5m. No other regions affected. Link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/synths/eu-west-1 (opening).
Sasha Kim: Any downstream customer impact seen? Traffic graphs look normal on first glance.
PagerDuty: Auto-escalation -> paging Ryan Patel (primary oncall).
Ryan Patel: Acked. Looking in.
Jamie L: FYI runtime team rolled a tiny nginx config change in eu-west yesterday (proxy buffer tweak). I’m checking whether that could cause 502s for the prober path.
Alex R: Quick repro from one prober host:
```
$ curl -i https://eu-west.redwood.ai/health
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx/1.21
Content-Type: text/plain

upstream sent invalid response
```
Prober logs show repeated backend connections closed:
```
[prober] 2026-03-14T02:11:23Z GET /chat/health -> 502 upstream reset
[prober] 2026-03-14T02:11:24Z GET /chat/health -> 502 upstream reset
```
Sasha Kim: Good catch. Customer-facing 5xx not elevated — likely probe hitting an internal path or backend that synthetic checks use.
Jamie L: I'm rolling through nginx config on the eu-west hosts to verify the change. If it is the proxy buffers, we'll try a rollback.
Alex R: Proposer mitigation: pause synthetic canary checks for eu-west to stop noisy pages, and suppress synth PagerDuty alerts for 15m while we roll back. We shouldn't hide a real outage, but this appears contained.
Maya Chen: Pausing synth job via console now: `opsctl synth pause --region eu-west-1 --job canary-small`
incident-bot: synth job "canary-small" in eu-west-1 paused by Maya Chen. Automatic alert suppression enabled for 10m.
Ryan Patel: I'll start rollback of yesterday's nginx change on the four eu-west proxy nodes. ETA ~7m. :hammer_and_wrench:
Jamie L: Rollback deployed to 4/4 proxies. Restarted nginx, tailing logs.
Alex R: After rollback, probe 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% and flaky 502s decreased. Canary still shows an isolated failure but much improved.
Sasha Kim: Customer impact assessment: backend user traffic shows no change in 5xx trends, no support tickets yet. Notifying CS to keep an eye: @cs-team.
Maya Chen: Handoff: I'm going offline in 20m, leaving Ryan as incident owner for the night. I will create a follow-up ticket for config audit and add steps to incident doc.
Ryan Patel: Taking over. I'll keep synthetic suppression until morning and watch dashboards. Filing follow-up: INFRA-3421 (nginx proxy config audit + revert gating).
Jamie L: Recommend we add a canary probe that hits the public health endpoint rather than the internal pool, and add a runbook step for quick pause/suppress.
Alex R: Agreed. Action items: 1) INFRA-3421, 2) update canary path, 3) add alert suppression playbook.
Sasha Kim: Marking this as mitigated for now — continue monitoring. :white_check_mark:
Ryan Patel: Thanks all, will update if anything changes. Leaving suppression on overnight and will re-enable canary job in the morning with small rollout.
